mysql-79902.title: GREATEST and LEAST return incorrect results with BIGINT UNSIGNED values
mysql-79902.expected: The first query should return 9223372036854775808, and the second should return 9223372036854775807, as GREATEST returns the maximum and LEAST returns the minimum of the provided arguments. 9223372036854775808 is a valid BIGINT UNSIGNED value (2^63), larger than 9223372036854775807 (2^63-1).
mysql-79902.notes: Affected versions: MySQL 5.5.48, 5.6.28, 5.7.8-rc, 5.7.10. The bug likely stems from internal signed integer conversion during comparison of BIGINT UNSIGNED values.
